purpose: Portable local activity receipts, identity-bound statistics and achievement unlocks for human and machine collaborators.
rules: Tracking is off until a local human explicitly opts in.
Pausing preserves history and refuses new receipts.
Applications submit verified result receipts; the service never infers authorship by scanning files, screens or activity.
Stable dedupe keys make retries safe.
Achievements may unlock profile visuals or exported metadata but never permissions, authority, purchases or access.
Human and machine members use the same identity, statistic and achievement record shapes.
A host may replace the achievement catalog and artwork without replacing the receipt engine.
Storage remains host-provided so another local Hub can use the service without copying AXM Hub UI code.

receiptTypes.game-played: One successfully started or completed game result, according to the host catalog rule.
receiptTypes.code-characters: An exact reviewed character count with evidence and a declared purpose mood.

hostResponsibilities: Provide local read and write adapters.
Ask for opt-in and expose pause, export and delete controls.
Submit receipts only after the declared result boundary is met.
Explain missing or stale receipt sources instead of displaying false synchronization.
